Subject: Important Update: Workshop Schedule Change

Dear Participants,

We are writing to inform you of a change to the schedule for the upcoming workshop. The practical session has been moved to the afternoon, allowing more time for hands-on activities. Registration will still begin at 8:45 a.m. as originally planned.

Lunch will be provided for all attendees. Please remember to bring your laptop, as it will be required for the practical session.

We appreciate your flexibility and look forward to seeing you at the workshop. Should you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Organization]
